group_assessment.weighting: Same group as PMID 37781246 in this wave; the two are not independent. A methodological self-dependency is disclosed in the text: the Evaluate Cutpoints tool used to choose the WWOX cut-point is the group's own, 'designed in our Department'.
group_assessment.note: Same Lodz group as PMID 37781246 in this wave -- Bednarek and Pluciennik senior, Kaluzinska and Kolat first. The group also authored the 'Evaluate Cutpoints' tool used to choose the WWOX cut-point here, which is disclosed in the text ('designed in our Department') and is a methodological self-dependency worth naming.

field_density.note: High WWOX density in the group, zero wet-lab measurement in this paper: every number comes from TCGA GBM/LGG RNA-seq (672 samples) and a UCSC Xena microarray cohort.

multihop.enumeration_method: <ref> elements counted in the JATS: 160. Not classified by gene-directedness.
multihop.note: No hop taken and none would change the verdict: the three readouts have no WWOX-perturbation experiment behind them in this paper or in any work it cites for them.

corpus_crossquery.query: Does any existing biomarker candidate name PLEK2, RRM2 or GCSH, and does section 13 admit a tumour-transcript correlate as a WWOX biomarker?
corpus_crossquery.finding: No existing candidate names them, and section 13 excludes them: a biomarker must measure the functional state of the gene, and a rank correlation between two transcript abundances in bulk tumour RNA-seq measures neither WWOX protein, nor WWOX activity, nor anything perturbed by changing WWOX.

retraction_check.result: No retraction, no expression of concern, no erratum. Article type 'Journal Article'.

entries.proposition: HOW 'WWOX-DEPENDENT' WAS ACTUALLY ESTABLISHED, AND IT IS THE WHOLE ANSWER TO THE BIOMARKER QUESTION: patients were split on a WWOX EXPRESSION CUT-POINT in bulk tumour RNA-seq. No knockdown, no overexpression, no perturbation of WWOX occurs anywhere in this study.
entries.snippet: Optimal WWOX expression cut-point was determined to separate high- and low-expressing groups of patients. The obtained cut-off value, 222.6, had significantly separated groups
entries.anchor: Results 2.1, 'WWOX Influenced a Number of Pathways and Biological Processes', first sentence

entries.proposition: AND THE SECOND LEG OF 'DEPENDENCE' IS A RANK CORRELATION ACROSS TUMOURS -- an association between two transcript abundances in the same bulk samples, which is not a measurement of WWOX function.
entries.snippet: was used to correlate the top genes with WWOX using Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient.
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods 5.8, 'Correlation Analysis and Survival Curves'

entries.proposition: THE ENTIRE STUDY IS COMPUTATIONAL, BY THE AUTHORS' OWN DESCRIPTION OF IT. 'Validated' here means replicated on a second public microarray cohort, not validated against WWOX function or in any disease population.
entries.snippet: A total of 672 samples were included in the study. Determining the suitable WWOX expression cut-point to stratify the population into two groups was achieved with the help of the R-based Evaluate Cutpoints tool designed in our Department
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods 5.1, 'Data Collection of Cancer Patients and Cut-Point Determination'

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS THEMSELVES DO NOT CLAIM THESE ARE USABLE BIOMARKERS. This sentence is why the triad is written into the model as a REJECTED candidate rather than as a candidate awaiting work.
entries.snippet: usefulness of PLEK2 , RRM2 , and GCSH as diagnostic or predictive biomarkers is yet to be confirmed

entries.proposition: The triad was chosen on four criteria at once, not ranked by correlation with WWOX. Table 3 (read cell-wise) gives GCSH R = 0.43, PLEK2 R = −0.44 and RRM2 R = −0.42 against WWOX, while three other top genes correlate more strongly: RNF141 R = 0.58, COL3A1 R = −0.51 and RXRG R = 0.45. The triad's correlations are mid-ranked, not the strongest.
entries.snippet: The selection of three the most relevant genes was based on their predictive value (AUC), effect on survival (DFS), correlation with WWOX, and transparency of expression difference across UMAP dimensions.
entries.anchor: Results, section on PLEK2, RRM2 and GCSH; Table 3 read cell by cell from the table markup
